title: Ola Roadster Electric Superbike Concept (Custom Edition)
description: The Ola Electric Ola Roadster Electric Superbike Concept (Custom Edition) is engineered for blistering apex speeds and track dominance, positioned in the Urban Electric Scooter segment for riders demanding engaging everyday dynamics. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against a curb weight of 108 kg, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. The cockpit is configured with an Step-Through Upright riding stance and an accessible 765mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
